backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining user profiles, brands, campaigns, tasks, KPIs, and RBAC‑protected CRUD utilities with map-based storage and sorting helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to source files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of all major frontend components, hooks, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base/theme configuration defining light/dark color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point providing root container and script loader for the frontend app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up router structure and route definitions for all app pages wrapped in AuthGate and AppShell.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication gate that handles Internet Identity state, profile loading, redirect to sign‑in, and initial profile setup.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting first‑time users to enter name and optional email before accessing the app.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireRole: Wrapper that checks user permissions and either renders children, a fallback, or an access denied alert.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Login screen using Internet Identity with loading states and error display.
frontend/src/components/brands/BrandDial: Dialog for creating a new brand with inputs for name, margin, and ad budget, submitting via useAddBrand.
frontend/src/components/brands/BrandEdit: Dialog for editing an existing brand’s margin, ad budget, and goals, submitting updates via useUpdateBrand.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Reusable empty‑state component with icon, title, description, and optional action.
Main app layout with sidebar navigation, mobile menu, user info, and logout handling.
Defines navigation items with labels, paths, and icons for the sidebar.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Campai: Dialog for adding a campaign with platform, spend, revenue, and ROAS calculation, submitted via useAddCampaign.
Sortable table displaying campaigns with platform badges, financial metrics, and underperformance highlighting.
frontend/src/components/MetricCard.tsx: Simple styled wrapper component for displaying metric cards.
frontend/src/components/PageHeader.tsx: Reusable page header with title, optional description, and optional action buttons.
frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskDialog: Form dialog to create a new task, handling description, priority, brand selection, due date, and submitting via useAddTask.
frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskList.t: Displays a list of tasks with checkboxes, badges, due dates, and handles status toggling based on user permissions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on user identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile through the actor with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, loading stored identities, login/logout, and exposing identity context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for CRUD operations on brands, campaigns, and tasks through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserRole.ts: Fetches the caller's role and provides helpers for role-mapping and permission checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables defining light/dark themes, colors, and print rules.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function to merge Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the App.
frontend/src/pages/brands/BrandDetailPag: Shows detailed brand info with edit and delete actions, handling loading and missing-brand states.
frontend/src/pages/BrandsPage.tsx: Lists brands with loading and empty states, provides navigation to brand details, and supports brand creation via a dialog.
frontend/src/pages/CROPage.tsx: Shows a placeholder page indicating CRO tools are coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays brand count metrics or empty/loading states and links users to create brands.
frontend/src/pages/KnowledgePage.tsx: Shows a placeholder for a future knowledge base.
frontend/src/pages/MarketingPage.tsx: Lists marketing campaigns with loading/empty states and provides a dialog to add new campaigns.
frontend/src/pages/OperationsPage.tsx: Shows a placeholder for future operations tracking tools.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Shows a placeholder for future product management tools.
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: Displays a placeholder for future reporting and export features.
frontend/src/pages/settings/AccessContro: Admin-only page providing a form to assign roles to principals via the backend actor, with validation and status messages.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Provides settings sections, including access control for admins and general settings info.
frontend/src/pages/TasksPage.tsx: Lists tasks with loading/empty states and allows creating new tasks via a dialog.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters, persisting them in session storage, and clearing them from URLs or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Project state file detailing overall app goals, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of implemented features with versions.
